record_type_quote: Here, we directly test each claim using a closely matched neuroimaging genetics approach in independent cohorts comprising 427 participants, four times larger than the original study of 94 participants.

targets.authors: Pinel P, Fauchereau F, Moreno A, Barbot A, Lathrop M, Zelenika D, Le Bihan D, Poline JB, Bourgeron T, Dehaene S
targets.title: Genetic variants of FOXP2 and KIAA0319/TTRAP/THEM2 locus are associated with altered brain activation in distinct language-related regions.
targets.evidence_quote: Because we sought to directly replicate the key findings reported by Pinel et al. (2012) , the ROIs for this study were based on the locations of the peak associations reported for each of the significant SNPs in that study ( Fig. 1 ).
targets.outcome_quote: Despite including a substantially larger sample, and a more powerful blocked design ( Birn et al., 2002 ), we did not replicate the Pinel et al. (2012) associations.

reasoning: Independent cohorts test three associations from one original paper; the authors state overall nonreplication. Other gene-association studies discussed as background are not targets.
